topic: End-of-service calculations that used to take a spreadsheet morning now run in seconds
format: Before/after of a single workflow: same task, two completely different experiences
post:
A finance manager in Muscat used to block out every Monday morning for one task: end-of-service calculations.

Pull the contracts. Cross-reference start dates. Check gratuity tiers. Build the spreadsheet. Double-check the math. Four hours, minimum — for a single batch of leavers.

With SmartPRO Hub, that same output takes seconds.

Finance teams across Oman and the GCC are now processing end-of-service entitlements automatically — gratuity calculations, final settlement breakdowns, WPS payroll Oman compliance — without touching a single formula.

We built this because spreadsheet errors in final settlements aren't just a time problem. They cause disputes, stall offboarding, and put businesses on the wrong side of Ministry of Labour requirements.

One platform handles the calculation, flags discrepancies, and feeds directly into your payroll run. No manual cross-referencing. No Monday morning blocked out in the calendar.

The question worth asking your team: how many hours a month are you still paying for work that should already be automated?
